source.title: Variational approach in abstract splines: Achievements and open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with identifier 898117. The official zbMATH API resolved the same record as Zbl 0852.41008: Rozhenko, A. I.; Vasilenko, V. A., "Variational approach in abstract splines: Achievements and open problems", East Journal on Approximations 1, No. 3, 277-308 (1995).

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/898117 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so zbMATH was treated as a resolver. The official zbMATH API record contained bibliographic metadata and review text but no full-text links, and API metadata was not used as a technical extraction source.

Bounded exact-work recovery attempted the zbMATH identifier, exact title, title plus PDF, title plus authors, journal/page range, Crossref title lookup, OpenAlex title lookup, and the East Journal on Approximations publisher homepage. Recovered candidates were only citing-paper PDFs, reference-list pages, author or serial metadata, or unrelated title matches; OpenAlex returned no same-title work, Crossref returned unrelated works, and darba-eja.com did not resolve in the local environment. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML page containing the problem statements was recovered.

trace.notes: No accepted questions were produced because no readable exact-work artifact was recovered. Extracting from zbMATH review text, abstracts, citation metadata, search snippets, or citing-paper references would violate the source adequacy and evidence coverage gates.
